title: The Messenger's Letter
content: You fear me because you have truly seen me, or because your elders told you to fear me? Before sunset I will wait for your answer. Do you still remember me?

title: The Hidden Sentence
content: The back of the letter says: Tell him I am still waiting for his answer.

title: The Blue Cloth
content: A torn strip of blue cloth carries the smell of mountain rain and bears a scale-shaped stitch.

title: A Child's Witness
content: The messenger stepped back whenever villagers raised firecrackers. He never attacked anyone.

title: The Maker's Note
content: Ten years ago the firecracker maker found a cold luminous object in a mountain crevice and sold it.

title: The Hunter's Notebook
content: The hunter's warnings about strange wind and falling water precede every major storm recorded in the village.

title: The Merchant's Ledger
content: A ledger records an unusual scale sold for a price far beyond an ordinary stone.

title: The Old Tablet
content: The old record calls Nian a mountain guardian who governs rain and protects living things.

title: The Mountain Pattern
content: The pattern inside the scale matches the ridge and the stream above the village.

title: The Fallen Scale
content: The pale scale is real, cold, and still faintly luminous. It is not a weapon or a common stone.

title: The Three Misread Signs
content: A claw mark, a tail bone, and tracks around the village were attempts to communicate, repeatedly interpreted as threats.

title: The Guardian's Answer
content: When the scale is brought near the messenger, the mountain wind settles and the stream begins to run clear.
